voice.voice_summary: Conor's voice is self-deprecating, irreverent, and deeply rooted in authentic ski-town and seasonnaire culture. His audience responds strongly to extreme powder riding and brutal stacks contrasted with degenerate humor (hangovers, reckless behavior), timely on-mountain resort drama, and niche skier-vs-snowboarder banter.
what_works: Juxtaposing responsible healthy claims with reckless extreme cliff drops ('Me: I don't vape... / Also me:')
Greenscreen pop-culture dancing cutouts composited directly over real mountain slopes for relatable scenarios
Ironic clickbait hooks over pristine Japow footage ('How I became a millionaire as a snow bum by 20')
Ground-zero documentary footage of extreme weather events with date, resort, and high stakes ('Blizzard @ Niseko 13/1/25')
Side-by-side or before-and-after expectation drops ('No one talks about how hard it is to go from this... To this...')
Gamified pop-culture payoff cuts (cutting from finding deep pow in trees to a glowing legendary Fortnite chest)
Documenting sketchy DIY projects with authentic Aussie banter, Bunnings runs, and real riding attempts
what_flops: Using generic, fullscreen movie/sports meme clips (e.g., Harry Potter, Neymar) that obscure riding footage
Posting raw riding clips without any text on screen or clear context
Low-effort seasonal filler statements ('Reminder: this is what Aus will look like this month')
Lazy, cliché captions and engagement bait ('Tag ur ski bro', 'Who's excited')
Noticeable typos in hooks ('watching snowboards pic regular') that kill viewer engagement

formats: Irony & Hypocrisy: 'Me: [Healthy/sensible statement] / Also me: [Dropping massive cliff/eating snow]'
Greenscreen Relatable Cutout: 'How [group/person] be moving on [snow condition]' over slope footage
Abrupt Contrast: 'No one talks about how hard it is to go from this... [idyllic lift] to this... [miserable cold chair]'
Gaming/Meme Metaphor: 'How it feels [rare mountain occurrence]' followed by a video game reward cut
'We Are Not The Same': '[Trendy reason people do something] vs [Self-deprecating reason I do it]'
tone_rules: Embrace authentic seasonnaire slang ('steeze', 'pow stash', 'first lift', 'snow bum', 'japow')
Keep hook text concise (1 to 2 short sentences max) centered cleanly on screen
Lean heavily into self-deprecation, hangover humor, and eating snow rather than showing off
Use casual lowercase or informal sentence casing without overly polished punctuation
Mild profanity or censored cursing ('eat sh*t', 'obliterated') fits the raw riding tone perfectly
Keep captions punchy with relevant location/mountain hashtags rather than long-winded essays
do_not: Do not post standalone meme clips that don't feature real snow or on-mountain riding
Do not post riding videos with no text overlay to anchor the joke or narrative
Do not use generic engagement-bait captions like 'Tag a friend' or 'Who is excited'
Do not publish with typos in the hook text (e.g., 'snowboards pic')
Do not post mundane, scenic weather pans without action, humor, or a storyline

x001.hook: Never stand below a park jump
x001.description: Landings are completely blind.|Take your hit, then clear out.|One person per feature always.
x001.ai_scene: Mascot landing off a park jump, looking ahead, and swiftly riding to the side to clear the landing zone.

x004.description: Push your board ahead instead.|Leaning back burns your quad.|Keep your core engaged.

x008.hook: Why you never chill in park landings

x010.description: Riders often fold at the waist|Heelside actually needs more flexion|Sink down through knees and hips
x010.manual_ref: APSI Manual: Heel side needs more flexion than toe side; core and glutes engaged so rider does not fold at waist
x010.ai_scene: Side profile of blocky snowboarder bending smoothly at the knees and hips on heel edge without breaking waist

x011.hook: Stop doing this on your toe turn
x011.description: Don't lift heels inside your boots|Keep ankles, knees and hips flexed|Drive pressure through balls of feet
x011.manual_ref: APSI Manual: Toe side weight on balls of feet, flexed joints. Never tippy toes or lifting heels.
x011.ai_scene: Close up of blocky mascot boots flexing forward naturally pressing into the snowboard toe edge smoothly

x012.hook: Telling your mate to ride trees in Japan

x013.hook: Why your board refuses to turn

x013.manual_ref: APSI Manual: Weight on back foot stops turning. Fix is more weight on front foot and matching shoulders to pitch.
